The latest split is the Form 990 for 2024 (https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/43512550/202522829349300322/full, Part III lines 4a-4d): methane pollution prevention (international) $5,110,438; advanced nuclear $4,957,200; fusion $2,003,331; other programmes $15,996,868 (US power-plant and carbon-capture advocacy, clean fuels and the rest; Schedule O gives no detail).
